capabilities.title: Per-capability risk policy table for agent skill definitions
capabilities.sourceEvidence: SkillSpector scans skill manifests for over-privileged capability grants
capabilities.adaptationNotes: SKILL_CAPABILITY_POLICIES table covers filesystem, network, process, secrets, agent-spawn, and memory capabilities with safe/review/blocked levels.

capabilities.title: Runtime evaluator that flags violations and warnings from declared skill capabilities
capabilities.sourceEvidence: SkillSpector evaluator compares declared tools against policy and returns violation report
capabilities.adaptationNotes: evaluateSkillCapabilities() used by CI scanner; blocked capabilities enforced in pre-tool-use hook.

capabilities.title: Integration with YAGNI violation patterns to flag scope-creep in skill plans
capabilities.sourceEvidence: SkillSpector and Ponytail complement: both target over-engineered agent behavior
capabilities.adaptationNotes: YAGNI_VIOLATION_PATTERNS cross-referenced in skill policy documentation.

capabilities.title: CI-integrated automated scanner for all skill manifests in the repository
capabilities.sourceEvidence: SkillSpector designed as a CI gate scanning .skill files pre-merge
capabilities.adaptationNotes: Scans .claude/skills SKILL.md for capability declarations; fails on blocked capabilities.

capabilities.title: Dependency graph analysis between skills to detect transitive privilege escalation
capabilities.sourceEvidence: SkillSpector advanced mode traces skill-to-skill calls for privilege chains
capabilities.reason: Nexus skills are currently flat; inter-skill call graph and transitive privilege analysis not implemented.

capabilities.title: NVIDIA GPU-accelerated batch skill scanning for large skill catalogs
capabilities.sourceEvidence: SkillSpector designed for NVIDIA hardware acceleration
capabilities.reason: Nexus has a small skill catalog; GPU-accelerated batch scanning adds infrastructure complexity with no benefit.
